Dehydrated Rosemary Leaves Supplier: Dehydrated Rosemary Leaves for Food Manufacturing

Dried rosemary is a working herb for bakers, roast-potato and meat processors, and anyone blending Mediterranean seasonings. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated rosemary leaves supplier in India, shipping clean, aromatic cut leaf to food manufacturers, seasoning companies, restaurants, importers and private label brands. Our product supports bulk production, retail packing, and custom ingredient programs. Rosemary leaves provide a distinctive herbal aroma and a warm, pine-like flavor. Dehydration helps reduce moisture while preserving the practical culinary value of the herb. As a result, buyers can store, transport, and use the product more easily than fresh rosemary. We offer bulk dehydrated rosemary leaves in practical commercial specifications. Our team can also review particle size, packaging, labeling, and supply requirements. Therefore, customers receive a product solution that fits their application and market.

Product Overview

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean and process the leaves under controlled food-processing conditions. Next, we remove foreign matter and sieve the dried material according to the agreed specification. The finished product works well in dry seasoning systems and savory recipes. It can also support foodservice and industrial applications. In addition, buyers may choose standard bulk supply or private label packaging through Tradenest Naturals.
  • Natural rosemary leaf ingredient for commercial food use
  • Suitable for seasoning, bakery, sauce, and ready-meal applications
  • Supplied as cut leaf at 10-20 mesh, with whole leaf on request
  • Produced for wholesale, export, OEM, and private label programs
  • Supplied with batch identification and a product specification sheet

Manufacturing and Processing

We begin with raw material inspection and careful grower selection. Then, our processing team removes visible impurities and unsuitable material. Controlled dehydration reduces moisture and supports better storage stability. After drying, we inspect the leaves for color, aroma, and physical condition. We then cut or sieve the leaves to meet the buyer’s required size. Finally, we pack the product in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Our process includes cleaning, dehydration, sorting, cutting, sieving, metal-control practices, packing, and batch traceability. However, the exact process can vary according to the customer specification. We confirm all commercial details before production.

Typical Technical Specifications

Standard commercial specifications provide a useful starting point for quotations. The values below appear on the product specification sheet shared with every quotation.
  • Form: Dried rosemary leaves
  • Particle options: Cut leaf; whole leaf on request
  • Typical mesh: 10-20 mesh for cut leaf
  • Typical moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Shelf life: 24 months
  • Color: Green to greyish green, depending on crop and processing
  • Flavor: Herbal, pine-like, woody, and mildly peppery
  • Additives: No added colors, preservatives, or fillers in the standard product
Actual values depend on the selected grade and agreed quality plan. We can provide a sample for review before a larger purchase. If your destination market needs analytical results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Quality and Food Safety

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We focus on raw material control, moisture management, sanitation, inspection, and batch traceability. These controls help support consistent quality across repeat orders. We review the buyer’s requirements before quotation. Customers can discuss allergen information, labeling rules and export paperwork with our team. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Every export order receives a documented review. This review covers product grade, packaging, labeling, shipping terms, and required commercial paperwork. As a result, the buyer and supplier share a clear supply plan before dispatch.

Applications

Dehydrated rosemary leaves add recognizable herbal character to many food products. They work especially well where manufacturers need convenient handling and stable storage. The leaves can enter a recipe directly or support a blended seasoning system.
  • Herb and spice blends
  • Pizza, pasta, and Italian seasoning
  • Roasted vegetables and potato products
  • Soups, sauces, gravies, and marinades
  • Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat meals
  • Bakery products, crackers, and savory snacks
  • Meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based products
  • Foodservice packs for restaurants and catering businesses
For example, a seasoning manufacturer may combine rosemary with garlic, onion, oregano, basil, and pepper. A prepared-food producer may use cut rosemary in marinades or oven-ready meals. Therefore, the ingredient supports both simple recipes and complex seasoning systems.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack the product in food-grade materials that resist moisture and help protect aroma. Standard options include inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, and bulk export bags. We also support custom printed and private label packaging. Shelf life is 24 months from the manufacturing date when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. The final shelf life depends on the packaging format, storage conditions, and approved product specification.
  • 1 kg and 5 kg packs for foodservice and smaller manufacturers
  • 10 kg and 25 kg packs for wholesale buyers
  • Bulk bags for large industrial orders
  • Custom retail packs for private label programs
  • Export-grade secondary packaging for international transport
Each pack can include product name, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions, and regulatory details. In addition, we can review destination-market labeling needs before printing.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Export Supply

Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. This works well for trial orders and for smaller brands. Private label orders and custom formulations need extra planning for packaging. Lead time depends on quantity and packaging, and starts after specification approval and payment terms. However, the schedule may change during peak seasons or for custom printed packaging. We confirm the production and dispatch plan with every quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your required quantity, destination country, preferred particle size, packaging format, and target application. Also share any labeling or documentation requirements. Our team will then review the request and send a clear commercial proposal. Samples are available on request.

Why Buy from Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals operates as a manufacturer, wholesale supplier, exporter, and food ingredient development partner. We support both established importers and growing brands. Our wider capabilities include grinding, sieving, blending, seasoning development, custom packing, and OEM manufacturing. We plan raw material ahead for repeat supply programs. We focus on practical specifications, transparent communication and clear export documentation. In short, we help buyers reduce sourcing complexity while maintaining product consistency.
  • Flexible supply for wholesale and export customers
  • Multiple particle sizes and packaging formats
  • Support for private label and OEM requirements
  • Batch-level product and packing traceability
  • Technical discussion before production
  • Competitive pricing for repeat and bulk orders

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Samples are available on request before your first order.

What quality documents do you provide?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What packaging and shelf-life options are available?

We offer 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, 25 kg, bulk, retail, private label, and export packaging options. Shelf life is 24 months in sealed, moisture-protected packaging.

What are the typical specifications?

Moisture is ≤ 8%, and the cut leaf is 10-20 mesh. We confirm the final specification before production.

How can I request a sample or quote?

Contact Tradenest Naturals with your quantity, destination, application, mesh preference, and packaging needs. We will review the request and respond with sample or quotation details.
